cards.title: Field crews lose 6.2 hours a week to paperwork

blocks.label: lost per crew each week to manual reporting

blocks.text: Every lost hour is billable time the contractor never invoices.

cards.notes: Open on the pain in the contractor's own units — hours, not features.

cards.title: Northwind turns a spoken site note into a filed report

items: Crew lead dictates 40 seconds of site notes on the drive back
Northwind fills the daily log, the safety form and the change order
Foreman approves from the phone; the office never rekeys anything

blocks.text: No new app for the crew — it runs on the phone they already carry.

cards.notes: Demo lives here in the live pitch. Keep the story to one crew, one day.

cards.title: Pilot crews cut reporting time by 71%

blocks.caption: Weekly reporting hours per crew, before and after (3 pilots)

blocks.text: All three pilots kept the change after the free period ended.

cards.notes: The retention line matters more than the hours — they paid to keep it.

cards.title: 180,000 US contractors run crews of five or more

blocks.text: Annual value assumes $49 per crew per month at today's pilot pricing.

cards.notes: Bottom-up only. If asked for top-down, the number is not the argument.

cards.title: Revenue grew from zero to $480K ARR in nine months
cards.notes: Growth is sales-led today; the self-serve motion is the use of funds.

cards.title: Unit economics hold at 4.6x LTV to CAC

blocks.label: LTV to CAC across the first 42 accounts

items: $1,180 blended CAC, two thirds of it founder-led selling
Net revenue retention of 118% on the eleven oldest accounts
Gross margin of 81% after inference and telephony costs

cards.notes: CAC rises when founder selling stops — say so before they ask.

cards.title: We are raising $3M to reach 1,000 crews by 2027

blocks.text: $3M on a $15M post, led, with 18 months of runway to Series A.

items: $1.4M to a six-person engineering team and the self-serve motion
$0.9M to two field sales hires in Texas and the Southeast
$0.7M to compliance packs for the four largest state regimes

cards.notes: Close on the milestone the round buys, not on the round itself.
